conventions.rig: Mixamo skeleton from Sitting_Talking.fbx (65 bones), skeleton only, 30 fps, frames start at 1
conventions.bowler_and_fielders: start at the origin facing the rig's forward direction; bowler appeals turn round to face the umpire who is BEHIND the start direction (the bowler has just followed through past him)
conventions.batters: rhb_/lhb_ clips start from the batting stance (same frame as the batting clips); bat on RightHand / LeftHand; top hand comes off the handle for the raises
conventions.helmet: bat_hundred: attach your helmet prop to the TOP hand between helmet_off_frame and helmet_on_frame
conventions.pairs: high fives / glove punch: the *_point_m is where the hands meet - place the partner so his hand reaches the same point on the same frame (mirrored clip or the same clip facing the other way)
conventions.huddle: team_huddle_loop: place 6-8 copies on a 0.75 m-radius circle facing the centre, offset their start frames
conventions.milestone_celebrations: owner delivery 2026-11-12 (milestone_*): bat_release_frame = the bat leaves the hand and falls; helmet_off/on_frame = helmet in the top hand between them; the somersault travels ~4.5 m
